# UX physical review

Automated review from the certified Android build:

- 61 Flutter tests passed, including operational one-handed states, code/rate-limit DTOs, accessibility semantics, and large-text layout coverage.
- 10/10 Moto G15 instrumentation tests passed.
- Automated launch, return, restart, and screen cycle completed without crash.

Manual ergonomic evidence is pending. It must be recorded one step at a time on the Moto G15 before pilot declaration: thumb reachability, keyboard vs. code CTA, exterior contrast, GPS state readability, connectivity feedback, notification privacy/tap/deduplication, and real route foreground-service stop.
